prompt: which cities should I visit in japan on a 30 day trip? I'm into history, culture, food, fashion/design, nightlife/clubbing
response: On a 30-day trip, you should focus on Tokyo for its vibrant nightlife, fashion, and food. Kyoto is essential for history and culture, but you can skip Osaka as it doesn't offer much beyond food. Tokyo alone can provide a balanced experience of all aspects you're interested in, so spending most of your time there would be ideal.
